what.en: The street address of the food facility being built or remodeled itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box.
what.zh: 填写正在新建或改建的食品设施本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: Write on the memo line: "DPH Plan Check Fee for [insert project address]."
Before constructing, enlarging, altering or converting any building for use as a food facility, two (2) sets of detailed plans

notes: Only address line is the facility's Business Address. California Health and Safety Code pages (leginfo, CDPH) could not be opened from this session; the SF construction guide restates the plan-submittal rule.
